headline: Former Takasbank General Manager Yunus Arıncı Re-Detained in Turkey
summary: Former Takasbank General Manager Yunus Arıncı has been re-detained in Turkey as part of an ongoing judicial investigation into investment funds.
why: Takasbank is Turkey's central clearing and settlement bank for financial securities traded on Borsa Istanbul.

impacts.name: Takasbank
impacts.why: Judicial investigations into former executive leadership present governance risks.
